neighbours.label: restrictive 'only' that picks a small subset out of a larger set ('only one of which', 'however only a few')
fire: The plant makes dozens of compounds, only two of which are toxic.
Hundreds of people applied, but only a handful were hired.
Of the forty species in the region, only three are endangered.
The museum owns many paintings, though only a fraction are on display.
Thousands of seeds fall each year, yet only a few become trees.
The team took twenty shots, and only one went in.
Several roads lead to the village, only one of which is paved.
Many drugs were tested; only a small number reached the market.
quiet: The plant makes dozens of compounds, two of which are toxic.
Hundreds of people applied, and a handful were hired.
Of the forty species in the region, three are endangered.
The museum owns many paintings, and a fraction are on display.
Thousands of seeds fall each year, and some become trees.
The team took twenty shots, and one went in.
Several roads lead to the village, one of which is paved.
Many drugs were tested; a small number reached the market.

notes: Probe: 'only one of which' 0.54, 'however only a few' 0.55, 'could only see' 0.21; 'even if' 0.01. The + pole's output suppresses one/some/certain, consistent with a set-restriction feature.
